# E M E R Technical Services

> E M E R Technical Services provides specialized engineering services for industrial laundry and commercial kitchen equipment in Deira, Dubai.

## Services

- Installation and commissioning
- AMC and preventive maintenance
- Breakdown repairs
- Equipment upgrades and spare parts
- Laundry equipment service and repair
- Laundry consumables and consultancy

### Laundry equipment

Dry-cleaning machines, washer extractors, dryers, tunnel washers and dryers, flatwork ironers, bed sheet and towel folders, pressing and marking machines, PCB, VFD and PLC repair, padding replacement, motor rewinding, boilers, and air compressors.

### Commercial kitchen equipment

Installation, maintenance, repairs, and upgrades for commercial kitchen equipment.
